current.text: Mitchell Robinson is gone and Andre Drummond replaces him. The projected starters are Brunson, Bridges, Hart, Anunoby and Towns, and little double-big use is expected.
Experts expect Robinson's absence to help his rebounds and possibly his FG%. His rebounds dropped when he played next to Robinson.
The Knicks won the championship. Towns is 30 and comes off a long Finals run.
Under coach Mike Brown, Towns plays fewer minutes than he did under Thibodeau, and the bench gets more minutes.

Experts expect the Knicks to be careful with his minutes after the Finals run. That means trimmed starter minutes, more rest on back-to-backs and about 31 minutes per game. They also see a small rise in injury risk from a championship hangover.
Experts think he may take a step back from last season. They rank him about 19th in 9-cat, call his pick 15 to 17 price too high and would not take him in the first round.
In an expert auction mock, Josh valued him at 30 USD or more. He sold for 36 USD.
The Knicks are projected to win about 50 to 54 games.

durable.text: He has a history of lower body problems, including knee issues.
He showed some signs of declining athleticism in the regular season but looked good in the playoffs.
Rebounds are his standout category, far above the top 250 pool.
He gives a strong FT% on good volume and real threes for a big.
His turnovers are high for his position, so the TO category is his weak spot.

note: Yahoo values him at 41 USD and ESPN drafters pay about 34.5 USD. Our league paid 46 USD for him last season. The experts put him at 30 USD or more and a mock auction sold him for 36 USD, so stop bidding in the mid 30s. His rebounds, FT% from a big and threes fit most builds, and they fit punt TO best. In the first 30 or so games, check his minutes (about 31 projected), his rest on back-to-backs, and whether his rebounds rise now that Robinson is gone.
